No project references, new runtime partials, containers, registries or service locators. Existing journal/file-size findings grow within the same saved-effect responsibility; callbacks execute outside catalog/SQL publication holds. Direct builds pass; 189 existing analysis diagnostics mean snapshot alone is not build proof. Focused behavioral proof pending; actual Workbench/Process producer, manager and historical paths remain closed.
